findings.asked: Compare accelerations for two options of pulling a block on a slope.
findings.wentWrong: Some computed both accelerations in the same direction and got one negative; sin/cos swapped; g omitted; arithmetic slips.
findings.rule: Resolve along the stated direction of motion so each acceleration comes out positive.

findings.asked: Resolve two forces at angles and find the resultant.
findings.wentWrong: Sin/cos mix-ups; some did not resolve one of the forces; some swapped the magnitude and the angle.
findings.rule: Each force: magnitude times cos or sin of ITS angle to the axis.

findings.asked: Block on a rough slope: friction, resultant, F = ma, then further motion.
findings.wentWrong: Diagram errors, then the usual sin/cos confusion; most identified the frictional force (33.6 N) and applied F = 7a; the follow-through into the final part was well done.
findings.rule: Along the slope: driving force minus friction minus weight component = ma.

ruleToRemember: Resolve along and perpendicular to the slope with the weight component mg sin(angle) along it; take the positive direction as the direction of motion; friction opposes motion.
